title: Step 65-C shared Storefront Wholesale session/data/recovery foundation and public introduction
description: MEDIUM-risk Step 65-C. Build the shared typed Storefront Wholesale read foundation and replace only the public /wholesale placeholder with the production Persian RTL introduction. Consume GET /auth/session, GET /customer/profile and GET /customer/wholesale/application through the existing server-side customer-session bridge. Preserve backend-owned eligibility/status/customer_type authority, recover safely to application/status routes, and do not implement submit/status mutation UX yet.

audit_findings: Public /wholesale is still a Step-65 placeholder.
Account Wholesale apply/status routes remain placeholders and are reserved for 65-D.
Customer session transport already exists server-side and safely bridges only the customer session cookie.
CustomerProfileResponse.customer_type is the current typed retail|wholesale authority.
GET /customer/wholesale/application is typed nullable and is the only customer-owned latest application authority.
Stage 65-C must not calculate discounts, hardcode wholesale thresholds or infer approval from local state.

acceptance_criteria.description: A typed Wholesale contract layer derives session, customer profile and latest wholesale application types only from generated OpenAPI; no local duplicate application/customer_type model is invented.

Server data loader uses the existing customer-session bridge, treats auth 401 as guest, fetches profile/application only for authenticated customers, preserves Set-Cookie rotation, and degrades non-auth failures to a recoverable unavailable state.

Public /wholesale is a production Persian RTL introduction with honest benefits/process copy, no guaranteed approval/discount claim, and CTA routing derived from authoritative state: guest/apply, active/status, approved/shop.

An active/submitted/under_review/rejected/approved application never creates frontend promotion authority. customer_type from profile remains authoritative for wholesale identity and application state is presented only as application state.

No wholesale price percentage, quantity threshold, Cart/Checkout parallel authority, browser token storage, backend/OpenAPI/database/dependency mutation or Step65-D form/status implementation is introduced.
Storefront verify includes the new wholesale foundation verifier without removing inherited Step59-64, API, auth, state or quality gates.

MEDIUM-risk canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release; no Owner Human Gate is required.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 65-C is MEDIUM risk; Human Gate is not required. Exact-artifact Review and Lock evidence remain mandatory.
